args.envDesc: The environment is real 3D geometry with one baked texture per surface, baked in Blender (Cycles) from the team's reconstruction of the artist's scene (no camera-projected plates at runtime), with mist / fog cards (Atmos), a true planar-mirror lake (real reflections of the environment, the sculpture and the cloud cards, concentric ripples, glint) and an anti-aliased waterline (tone-compressed MSAA resolve plus a waterline temporal AA, merged today).
args.known: The press-and-hold follows the CLIENT'S OWN WORDS, which override the State video on purpose: every ring keeps rotating continuously in slow motion in its rest direction while the outer rings open by an offset ('continuous slow-motion idle rotation + opening offsets'; the client's explicit hold instructions take precedence over the video's hand-keyed demo layout), so the hold poses p04-p08 will NOT match the reference ring by ring or the exploded spread of F402-F444: judge the hold's quality (opened shape reads clearly, motion continuous, no intersections or glitches, camera dolly, fog, light), not its distance from the video's ring layout. The click-triggered collapse was removed on purpose; a click does nothing. During the hold the headline dissolves with an ink-on-paper animation (client request). The UI overlay comes from the Figma 'Coming Soon' frame.
